findings.summary: Requirement R1 (recursive Markdown discovery) is traced to milestone M2 but M2 deliverables do not explicitly include recursive discovery implementation; only File Collector Plugin (C9) is mentioned without confirming recursive behavior.

evidence.note: R1 requires recursive discovery of .md files.
evidence.quote: The system MUST accept a user-specified folder (or repository working directory) as input and recursively discover Markdown (.md) files

evidence.note: M2 deliverables list File Collector Plugin but do not explicitly confirm recursive discovery implementation.
evidence.quote: File Collector Plugin (C9): recursive .md discovery, include/exclude patterns, default symlink policy documented

evidence.note: AT1 pass criteria requires recursive discovery but M2 exit criteria do not explicitly verify AT1 passes.
evidence.quote: All .md files in all subfolders are included as notes; non-.md files are excluded.

findings.summary: Requirement R2 (static-only output) is traced to milestones M1 and M2, but M1 deliverables focus on orchestrator/plugin API without any output generation capability; R2 cannot be validated at M1 exit.

evidence.note: R2 requires static website output with no server-side runtime.
evidence.quote: The system MUST generate a static website output consisting only of static files (HTML/CSS/JS/assets)

evidence.note: M1 deliverables are orchestrator/plugin API only; no rendering or output generation.
evidence.quote: Core Orchestrator (C8) with deterministic lifecycle hook ordering (init/collectFiles/transform/resolve/render/finalize)

evidence.note: AT2 validates R2 but is not listed in M1 exit criteria.
evidence.quote: Build completes successfully; output contains only static assets (HTML/CSS/JS/media)

findings.summary: Requirement R3 (Markdown rendering with formatting preservation) is traced to milestones M1 and M2, but M2 deliverables include only Markdown Parser Plugin (C10) which emits AST, not rendered HTML; rendering is deferred to M3 (DL10), creating a gap.

evidence.note: R3 requires parsing and rendering Markdown to HTML with preserved formatting.
evidence.quote: The system MUST parse and render each input Markdown file into a corresponding static HTML page while preserving Markdown formatting

evidence.note: M2 DL6 delivers parser that emits AST, not rendered HTML.
evidence.quote: Markdown Parser Plugin (C10): CommonMark baseline with optional GFM extensions toggle; frontmatter extraction; emits AST/plain-text

evidence.note: Renderer plugin skeleton is delivered in M3, not M2.
evidence.quote: Renderer/Theme Plugin skeleton (C14) capable of rendering note pages

evidence.note: AT3 validates R3 rendering but M2 exit criteria claim AT3 passes despite no renderer.
evidence.quote: AT3 passes for the selected baseline Markdown features on the fixture set.
